result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't add tests for the new matches or run a check against sample files.

- **`addBuildAndDeploymentConventions`:** the Gradle JavaScript rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so any `*-gradle.js` file matches (it was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`). `build.gradle` still matches its own rule.
- **`addGeneratedConventions`, `.htm` pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](html|htm|xhtml)`. The old pattern listed `html` twice and left out `htm`.
- **`addGeneratedConventions`, `<doc>` and `// Generated by` files:** the `.NET` `<doc>` rule is now `.*[.]xml` and the JavaScript `// Generated by` rule is now `.*[.]js`. Both were `.*/[.]…`, which only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`.

The file-name patterns still require the right extension and the content patterns are unchanged, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes.
